La Slem bah ba nga kwah ban pynmih pyrthei ia

Volume-2, Volume-3 bad ia ka Volume-4. 

Ki khynnah kiba la kot ia ka 5 snem karta ki 

lah ban don hikai ban pynkilanmet ialade hapoh ka 
jingialam jong kiba la kham san bad kiba la pule 
bniah ia kane ka kot. Bad kane ka kot U 

MAWKORDOR KA JINGIM kan hikai ia ki khynnah, ia 
ki samla bad ia kiba la rangbah ba kin long ki briew

ban don ka jingmut jingpyrkhat kaba khuid, ban long ki 
briew kiba lah ban iai-shah bad kiba iai-neh bad ban 
long ki briew kiba shlur bad kiba shemphang.

Ka Kilanmet ka dei ka jingkyrkhu ia u Briew 
aba burom bad khein kor ia ka. U briew uba 
Kilanmet mania ka step kumba 20 minit ne 30 minit 
an ioh ka met ka phad kaba koit kaba khiah kiat bha, 
Un lait na ki jingpang kiba harukom. U briew uba 
smat ban kilanmet wat lada un poi ha ka rta kaba 70 
ne 80 snem ruh, un ym pat ring tymmen than haduh 
katta katta. Hynrei u briew u bym ju pynkilanmet pat, 
11 JU ring tymmen kloi wat la ka rta jong u ka dang 
long tang 50 ne 60 snem. 

1) Ka jingshisha:- U Rangbah briew uba la dap 

80 snem karta ruh haba u kilanmet man la ka step, u 

Syngkai, u Budlum, u Ryndang, ki Pungkti, ki Pungkjat 
ki long kiba khlain bad kiba skhem, ki long ruh kiba

lab ban pynphai ne khyrwait kat sha barnon, bad ka 
met ka phad ka khlain bad ka koit ka khiah bha, bad 
ka snam ha ka met ka khuid bad ka iaid bha. U 
briew u lah ban pynphai kynsan ia la ka met wak 
wak katba u sngewbit. 

2) U Khynnah uba dang 15 snem karla ruh lada 

um JU pynkilanmet, ii eh syngkai bad lada u bakla, u 
kum ur, kyllon ne hap, u khynnah un rnynsaw jur, un 

lait ka syngkai, khein u shyieng budlum bad kiwei 

kiwei ki jingma ia u. 

3) Sa kawei pat ka jingmyntoi kaba kongsan tarn 

ka long ba u briew uba pynkilanmet bha ialade u 

nangkham pynjlan shuh shuh ia la ka karta katba u 

dang im ha kane ka pyrthei. Namar da ka lad 

pynkilanmet, u briew u koit u khiah krat bha bad um 

JU kham pang biej. Ki briew ki bym ju pynkilanmet

hangne.

Kham bun ngut ngin shem bad ia kynduh ia ki

Lada kine ki briew kin jin da la pynkilanmet ialade ha

Ka jingbam da ka por bad da ka jingthew ka 
long kaba donkam, khamtam lei lei ia u Nongkilanmet.
